# 18 — Firestore project config + minimal backend stub

**What to build:** Firebase project configuration in `lib/backend/firebase.dart` initializing Firebase Core, Cloud Firestore, and Firebase Storage with a single config file (`firebase_options.dart` generated by FlutterFire CLI). Stub collections: `relay/{channel_id}/messages` for BROADCAST, `relay_direct/{recipient_id}/messages` for DIRECT, `verified_orgs/{org_id}` for ALERT allowlist, `evidence/{recipient_id}/records` for vault uploads. README documents the Firebase project setup steps (create project, enable Firestore + Storage, drop config).

**Blocked by:** #01

**Status:** ready-for-agent

- [ ] Firebase Core, Firestore, Storage initialized on app start
- [ ] Config file present (Firebase-generated, checked in — flag in README that this is a demo project)
- [ ] App builds and runs without crashing when offline (Firestore must not block startup)
- [ ] `relay/{channel_id}/messages` schema documented: `{ id, sender_id, created_at, payload_b64, ratchet_header?, ttl, hop_count, signature, expires_at }`
- [ ] All entries include `expires_at` (server-side TTL via Firestore TTL policy in console; documented in README)
